snippet.title: Collie Call | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #CollieCall

🐶Collie Call | Launch Trailer🐶
 🐑Available for Playstation, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Microsoft Store!

In Collie Call, you’re a super-smart pup on a mission: herd all the sheep back to the pasture!

KEY FEATURES:
﻿﻿﻿﻿🐑Herd all the sheep using logic and clever movement in 30 levels;
﻿﻿﻿﻿🐑Enjoy a colorful pixel-art style that brings every sheep and farm to life;
﻿﻿﻿﻿🐑Deal with spinning sheep, slippery mud, and crazy teleporters;
﻿﻿﻿﻿🐑Easy controls, quick resets, and instant undo — think freely;

Get yours:
🐑 Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015132
🐑 Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/collie-call-switch/
🐑 Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/collie-call/9npgk53fc6zw
🐑 Xbox One: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/collie-call-xbox-one/9nhbrn7m7zw1
🐑 Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p6jpsnm49wc?hl=en-US&gl=US
